mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) signals strong household demand for housing, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing supply chain recovery phase (indicated by INDPRO rising above 100 for three consecutive months), industrial production growth supports corporate output and margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: During periods when INDPRO is above 100 for three consecutive months, the S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 3.5% year-over-year, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y, the S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing activity, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that may lead to wage inflation and central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 4.0% for two consecutive months, the S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong household demand, which together drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS increases fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.
